bios: Melina is a PhD student at UIUC and Software Engineer at Verkada. Her research interests are at the interesection of CS Education and HCI. She earned her Bachelor's and Master's degrees in Computer Science from the University of Michigan, Ann Arbor.

Since her Master's, she has been a Software Engineer at Verkada working on the design system and frontend component library. She also has over 2 years of teaching experience for the Web Systems course at Michigan.

She is passionate about web development, teaching and education, supporting women in STEM, and perpetual learning. In her free time, she enjoys playing music, listening to tech podcasts, and learning about Emacs.
